answer.chase_next: The single-seat route, where I build REP to 60 first, to see what getting invited into politics and becoming a minister actually looks like. I want the title's big payoff.
answer.play_again_why: The leak callback hooked me and I want to see what a higher REP run does. The run was short, so another go is quick, but I would want more choices in the later years.
